hostAssumptions: Array.findIdx? returns the first index whose predicate is true.
Array.eraseIdx! removes an in-bounds element and preserves the order of the remaining elements.
The compiled array ABI uses a 48-byte allocation header followed by an 8-byte length and 8 bytes per UInt64 element.
Returning the input unchanged may reuse its existing array allocation; the initial heap top already lies above the input representation.
